goal: Create a network scanning tool that can perform comprehensive scans of networks, gather device information, and output results in JSON format.
acceptance_criteria: The tool must support scanning IP ranges using CIDR notation
It must scan specified ports on each host and report open/closed status
Proper error handling for socket operations and DNS resolution is implemented
Output must be in JSON format for easy parsing
All functions are properly exported and accessible
Comprehensive test suite passes with proper socket handling and DNS resolution
